name: VoiceMate classroom demo phrasebook
license: Prototype data — validate with native Santhali educators before real classroom use
notes: Small manually assembled demonstration set. This is not a machine-learning training corpus.

phrases.hindi: तीन आम और दो आम मिलाकर कितने आम होंगे?
phrases.olChiki: ᱯᱮ ᱟᱢ ᱟᱨ ᱵᱟᱨ ᱟᱢ ᱥᱮᱞᱮᱫ ᱠᱟᱛᱮ ᱛᱤᱱᱟᱹᱠ ᱟᱢ ᱦᱩᱭᱩᱜᱼᱟ?
phrases.roman: Pe am ar bar am selet kate tinak am huyuk'a?

phrases.olChiki: ᱢᱤᱫ ᱠᱷᱚᱱ ᱜᱮᱞ ᱫᱷᱟᱹᱵᱤᱡ ᱞᱮᱠᱷᱟ ᱢᱮ।
phrases.roman: Mit khon gel dhabij lekha me.
